integrity: No external independent audit; finite checks and a self-contained proof are provided.
scientific_limitations: The even-parameter classification is the putatively new part. The odd-parameter graph structure is covered by previously published results and is included for context. Generalised dicyclic groups with noncyclic kernels are not classified. Computational examples check but do not prove the general statement; priority beyond inspected literature is not certified.
title: A parity transition in symmetric normaliser graphs of dicyclic groups
